text:
maria: quick nsys question — profiling a KV-cache eviction spike and short captures keep missing the kernel bursts. any tricks?
ajay: bracket the region with NVTX and use capture-range. also reduce sample interval so the short kernels aren't missed. e.g.:
```
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt \n  --capture-range=nvtx:kv_batch_start:kv_batch_end \n  --sample=cpu --sample-interval=1000 \n  -o runs/kv-evict-test ./docker-entrypoint.sh "python -m my_serving_run"
```
ken: +1 to nvtx brackets. we usually do --trace=cuda,osrt,nvtx (order doesn't matter) and a ~30s window after warmup: --duration-ms=30000. wrap the batching loop with nvtxPushRange/nvtxPopRange. that way the timeline focuses on kernel selection during batched decode.
maria: good call — does osrt add a lot of overhead? how do we interpret those host-side markers?
ajay: osrt is lightweight and helps show scheduler stalls/host-side async gaps — useful for batching heuristics (why batch size X stalls vs X+1). in timeline, look for long gaps between kernel launches + OSRT thread states.
ken: also watch sample bias: if you capture too short the sampler misses infrequent long kernels. if file size balloons, try smaller interval or restrict traces to cuda+nvtx only for bigger runs.
perf-bot: reminder: short/run sampling bias: increase capture window or do repeated tiny captures and merge stats. :warning:
maria: sharing the command I just tried (failed to capture the hotspot):
```
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --capture-range=nvtx:batch_1:batch_2 --sample=cpu --sample-interval=2000 -o /tmp/kvtest ./bin/serve --model small --batch-size 8
```
ajay: try --sample-interval=800 or 1000 (us) if those kernels are <1ms. and move capture-range to start after 5 warmup batches. e.g., nvtx:warmup_done:start -> nvtx:steady:end.
ken: one more: compare name/duration distribution between early batches and steady-state. KV cache warmup shows different kernel selection (more prefetch/eviction kernels early). use a 10s steady-state bracket for comparison.
maria: ok will rerun with nvtx markers around steady-state and tighter sampling. i'll upload the .qdrep when done. thanks!
